disposition_reason: Table 2 prints Pb and Cd per beer sample (63 beers) and Table 4 prints group means; beer is a proxy matrix for distilled spirits.

study.origin: Breweries in 20 districts of six Brazilian states (São Paulo, Paraná, Rio de Janeiro, Rio Grande do Sul, Minas Gerais, Pará)
study.market: Markets and shops in the same six states
study.method: Graphite furnace AAS with Zeeman correction after dilution in Triton X-100/HNO3; NH4H2PO4 modifier
study.qa: Spike recovery Pb 91% (n=16), Cd 76% (n=16); results corrected for recovery; NIST SRM 1515 Apple Leaves and SRM 1547 Peach Leaves within certified ranges
